name: Hiba Airi
source: A schoolgirl who is a long time fan of magical girls and dream of becoming one. This was due to her idolizing the magical girl that came into town 7 years ago. As she was walking on the street, she came across the mascot Shamii fighting a monster and made her contract. Thus, she became Magical Girl Lovely Lily. However, Airi did not realize that being a magical girl is quite different from what she always dreams of.
